fusions.name: End of the Stalk
fusions.desc: A pounce at an enemy up to 3.5 tiles away, usable only on one at or below 30% health. It deals 20 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have walked since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Pebble-Still Ambush
fusions.desc: Lashes a paw out at the first enemy in its path, which deals 4 damage. It has 40% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Bask on the Sill
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 6 seconds, and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Lands Right Side Up
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
